Sam (Support): Quantumeta reports they were billed twice for a batch export job last night (INV-2026-1022). They provided a screenshot and say delta ≈ $2,150. Link: https://app.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-1022
Marta (Customer Success): They said the second run was triggered by our retry after a 502. Customer impact: cashflow concern, asks for refund to card.
Sam (Support): From logs: job_id=qx-7743 ran at 02:13 and 02:14 UTC, second run processed identical payloads. Extra tokens: 430k, est cost $2,150.
Ravi (Finance): Proposal: remove duplicated usage (-$2,150) and offer a $250 goodwill for disruption -> total $2,400. Goodwill <= $500 ok. GL code: FIN-CR-03.
Marta (Customer Success): Customer prefers refund to card. Approve refund path?
Ravi (Finance): I approve. Will route to payments. Please confirm card refund request in writing from customer.
billing-bot: Created credit memo TKT-10007 amount: 2400 GL: FIN-CR-03 action: refund to card, owner: @payments-team, eta: 2026-03-26.
Sam (Support): I emailed customer asking them to confirm refund to card. Will attach confirmation to ticket once received.
Marta (Customer Success): Thanks — keeping customer updated.
Ravi (Finance): Processing note: `adj:TKT-10007` added to INV-2026-1022. Close when payment ops confirms refund.
